name: Iraq Virtual Museum
summary: This application serves as a digital gateway to Iraq’s cultural heritage by documenting and presenting more than 15 significant heritage sites across the country. Through immersive virtual tours, users are able to explore these historic locations remotely, gaining insights into their architectural, cultural, and historical value without the need for physical presence.
